def transform(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find background = most common
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find non-bg colors
    others=[v for v in c if v!=bg]
    # assume one color forms a hollow frame rect, other is small pattern

    for col in others:
        pts=bbox(col)
        if len(pts)<4: continue
        i0=min(p[0] for p in pts); i1=max(p[0] for p in pts)
        j0=min(p[1] for p in pts); j1=max(p[1] for p in pts)
